description: This file defines the ComponentMetadata class for managing component metadata in Drupal, including properties, schema parsing, and thumbnail retrieval.

classes.name: ComponentMetadata
classes.description: Represents metadata for a Drupal component, including properties, schema parsing, and utility methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ComponentMetadata object with provided metadata, app root, and schema enforcement flag.

methods.name: parseSchemaInfo
methods.description: Parses and validates the schema information from component metadata.

methods.name: getThumbnailPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the component's thumbnail image.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized array representation of the component metadata.
